sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sa_pattern"><sa_pattern action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><ci_type>cmdb_ci_firewall_manager</ci_type><cpattern_type>3</cpattern_type><description/><directory>false</directory><enforce_proc_classy>false</enforce_proc_classy><invoke_per_account>false</invoke_per_account><metadata_id>8eddc66697041310a4c3ba6de053af67</metadata_id><name>Barracuda Control Center</name><ndl>pattern {
	metadata {
		id = "8eddc66697041310a4c3ba6de053af67"
		name = "Barracuda Control Center"
		description = "Discovery pattern for Barracuda Control Center"
		citype = "cmdb_ci_firewall_manager"
	}
	identification {
		name = "discovery"
		entry_point {type = "*"}
		find_process_strategy {strategy = NONE}
		step {
			name = "Get status map"
			custom_operation {
				attributes {
					attribute {
						name = "required_authentication"
						value = "true"
					}
					attribute {
						name = "url"
						value = concat {
							"https://"
							get_attr {"cc"}
							":"
							get_attr {"port"}
							"/rest/cc/v1/ranges/1/statusmap?expand=true"
						}
					}
					attribute {
						name = "headers"
						value = "Accept: application/json"
					}
				}
				sys_id_op = "99a9f95a9f3312003cb191aec32e70e9"
				to_var_names = "SystemVariable"
				parsing_strategy = empty_strategy {}
				if_not_found_do = nop {}
				is_paginated = 0
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Transform raw status map"
			set_attr {
				"statusMap"
				eval {"javascript: // Raw JSON text returned by the statusmap call
var rawText = ${SystemVariable};

// Parse the text into a JavaScript object
var parsed = JSON.parse(rawText);

// Output array: one object per box (firewall / control center)
var result = [];

// Level 1: cluster names are keys
var clusterNames = Object.keys(parsed);

for (var i = 0; i < clusterNames.length; i++) {
    var clusterName = clusterNames[i];
    var clusterObject = parsed[clusterName];

    // Level 2: box names are keys
    var boxNames = Object.keys(clusterObject);

    for (var j = 0; j < boxNames.length; j++) {
        var boxName = boxNames[j];
        var boxObject = clusterObject[boxName];

        // New flat object with the keys promoted to attributes
        var boxCopy = {};
        boxCopy.cluster = clusterName;
        boxCopy.name = boxName;

        // Copy all original attributes (nested objects are kept as they are)
        var attributeNames = Object.keys(boxObject);

        for (var k = 0; k < attributeNames.length; k++) {
            var attributeName = attributeNames[k];
            var attributeValue = boxObject[attributeName];
            boxCopy[attributeName] = attributeValue;
        }

        result.push(boxCopy);
    }
}

// Serialize back to text so the next step can parse it with JSONPath
var resultText = JSON.stringify(result);

rtrn = resultText;"}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Parse status map"
			parse_var_to_var {
				from_var_name = "statusMap"
				to_var_names = table {
					name = "devices"
					col_names = "name","serial","mgmtIp","accessIp","model","phionVersion"
				}
				parsing_strategy = custom_parsing_strategy {
					sys_id = "512a3d5a9f3312003cb191aec32e708a"
					rootXpath = "/root"
					fields {
						field {
							col_name = "name"
							xpath = "/root/*/name/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "serial"
							xpath = "/root/*/serial/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "mgmtIp"
							xpath = "/root/*/mgmtIp/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "accessIp"
							xpath = "/root/*/accessIp/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "model"
							xpath = "/root/*/model/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "phionVersion"
							xpath = "/root/*/phionVersion/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "forEach"
							for_each = "forEach"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
					}
				}
				if_not_found_do = nop {}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Filter for CC"
			filter {
				src_table_name = "devices"
				target_table_name = "controlCenter"
				condition = any {
					starts_with {
						"VC"
						get_attr {"devices[].model"}
					}
					is_empty {get_attr {"devices[].mgmtIp"}}
				}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Insert CC into CMDB"
			transform {
				src_table_name = "controlCenter"
				target_table_name = "cmdb_ci_firewall_manager"
				operation {
					set_field {
						field_name = "host"
						value = get_attr {"controlCenter[].name"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "name"
						value = get_attr {"controlCenter[].name"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "hostname"
						value = get_attr {"controlCenter[].name"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "serial_number"
						value = get_attr {"controlCenter[].serial"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "ip_address"
						value = get_attr {"controlCenter[].accessIp"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "model_id"
						value = get_attr {"controlCenter[].model"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "model_number"
						value = get_attr {"controlCenter[].model"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "manufacturer"
						value = "Barracuda Networks, Inc."
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "firmware_version"
						value = get_attr {"controlCenter[].phionVersion"}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Filter for firewalls"
			filter {
				src_table_name = "devices"
				target_table_name = "devices"
				condition = any {
					not_starts_with {
						"VC"
						get_attr {"devices[].model"}
					}
					is_not_empty {get_attr {"devices[].mgmtIp"}}
				}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Insert firewalls into CMDB"
			transform {
				src_table_name = "devices"
				target_table_name = "cmdb_ci_ip_firewall"
				operation {
					set_field {
						field_name = "name"
						value = get_attr {"devices[].name"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "serial_number"
						value = get_attr {"devices[].serial"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "ip_address"
						value = get_attr {"devices[].mgmtIp"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "model_id"
						value = get_attr {"devices[].model"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "model_number"
						value = get_attr {"devices[].model"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "manufacturer"
						value = "Barracuda Networks, Inc."
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "firmware_version"
						value = get_attr {"devices[].phionVersion"}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Create relationships"
			relation_reference {
				table1_name = "cmdb_ci_ip_firewall"
				table2_name = "cmdb_ci_firewall_manager"
				result_table_name = "firewalls_to_cc"
				unmatched_lines = keep
				relation_type = "Managed by::Manages"
				ref_direction = parentToChild
				ref_field_name = ""
			}
		}
	}
}
